tasks.title: Persistent backfill-state indicator as a permanent status-bar widget (D53.1)
tasks.description: Create one permanent backfill-state widget as a QStatusBar.addPermanentWidget child of MainWindow.status_bar (created once with the bar, never a showMessage caller). Raise it when a wave is issued (queue-only waves included) and refresh it on wave events from the session wave state (in-flight count, queued-plan count, elapsed, current reqIds). All existing showMessage texts and timings stay byte-identical: the indicator is purely additive.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Given an in-flight history wave with the indicator raised, when an unrelated transient status message is issued (e.g. the account-summary receipt shape), then the indicator widget identity and its reported state (in-flight count, queue count, elapsed time, current reqIds) are unchanged.

AC2: Given a wave issue including a queue-only instant (all plans queued, zero in-flight yet), when the indicator raises and refreshes at multiple wave instants, then it reports at minimum the in-flight count, the queued-plan count, the wave elapsed time, and the current in-flight reqIds.
AC3: Given the pre-existing transient showMessage call sites, when this task lands, then every pre-existing showMessage text and timing is unchanged (the indicator adds a surface, it replaces none).

tests.description: Offscreen MainWindow with a seeded BarCache missing span so load_chart issues a multi-chunk wave; capture the indicator object and its state, inject an unrelated showMessage (account-summary receipt shape), then assert the indicator is the same object with identical reported state.
tests.expected_result: RED on the current tree (no such permanent widget exists); GREEN after: indicator identity and state unchanged across the injected transient traffic.

tests.description: Offscreen wave driven through issue (assert the queue-only instant reports queued-plan count with zero in-flight), first-chunk progress, and continuation ticks; assert the at-least content set (in-flight count, queue count, elapsed, reqIds) at each instant.
tests.expected_result: Indicator reports the at-least set at every sampled instant including the queue-only instant; extra fields are permitted, missing fields fail.

tests.description: Offscreen scripted wave capturing the transient showMessage sequence (wave-issue 'backfilling N historical chunk(s)' text, cached-bars text, coalesced-reload notice) and assert it equals the pre-change sequence with unchanged texts and timeouts.
tests.expected_result: All captured transient texts and timings match the pre-change values exactly; no showMessage call site reworded or retimed.

expected_artifacts: Permanent backfill indicator widget in ui/main_window.py
inputs: Wave-issue sites in load_chart; session wave state (_history_req_ids, _wave_plan_queue)
outputs: Raised/refreshed permanent indicator reporting counts + elapsed + reqIds

tasks.title: Indicator lifecycle on the four terminal paths with coalesced-keep (D53.2)
tasks.description: Hook the P14-T1 indicator into the four existing wave-terminating paths (normal completion in _finalize_history_wave, stranded finalization in _finalize_stranded_history_wave, cancellation in the load_chart cancel block plus teardown, disconnect in _on_disconnected) so each clears it exactly once. Add the in-memory wave-start timestamp on the session (set once at first plan issue, cleared on termination) so elapsed is a pure read; the Branch-A same-triple early-return keeps the running indicator with its baseline unreset.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Given a live indicator, when each terminal path fires (normal completion / stranded watchdog finalization / cancellation via symbol switch or new-triple load / disconnect), then the indicator clears exactly once per path.

AC2: Given an in-flight wave, when a same-triple (symbol, timeframe, ext-hours) reload arrives mid-wave (Branch A), then no new historical reqId is issued, the generation does not advance, and the indicator keeps running with its elapsed baseline unreset.

AC3: Given an in-flight wave, when a mode-switch (ext-hours toggle) load arrives mid-wave, then the old wave cancels, the indicator clears, and a new wave re-raises it (a clear-and-reraise, not a keep).

tests.description: Parametrized offscreen case over the four terminal paths driving the real session callbacks (per-chunk completion to empty, watchdog timeout injection, symbol-switch load, disconnect injection); assert the indicator clears exactly once on each path.
tests.expected_result: RED on the pre-fix tree (no per-path clearing exists); GREEN after: exactly-once clear on all four paths.

tests.description: Offscreen mid-wave same-triple reload; record issued reqIds, _history_generation, the indicator object, and the elapsed baseline before and after; assert no new reqIds, unchanged generation, same indicator object, and elapsed continuity (baseline unreset).
tests.expected_result: No new reqIds, generation unchanged, indicator keeps running with elapsed unreset.

tests.description: Offscreen mid-wave mode-switch load (ext-hours toggle); assert the old wave cancels (old reqIds cancelled, generation advanced) and the indicator clears then re-raises for the new wave.
tests.expected_result: Clear-and-reraise observed as a new wave, never a keep of the old indicator state.

expected_artifacts: Lifecycle hooks + wave-start timestamp in ui/main_window.py and ui/ticker_session.py
inputs: P14-T1 indicator raise/refresh/clear API; existing terminal paths and Branch-A early-return
outputs: Indicator cleared exactly once per terminal path; coalesced reload keeps it with baseline intact

tasks.title: Cache-current claim guard plus batch history gate (D53.3/D53.4)
tasks.description: Add a single _is_cache_current predicate (planner reports zero missing spans for the current symbol/timeframe/mode AND no wave in flight) consulted by the no-plans branch and the finalize path, so no 'Cache current' or equivalent freshness claim shows while a wave is in flight or spans are missing; stranded-with-missing-days keeps the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall. Verify the D53.4 history gate (D41-D52 sections, marker sentence, Current Tech Stack intact; no pre-D53 wording touched) and the full offscreen suite green.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Given an in-flight wave or planner-reported missing spans for the current triple, when the no-plans branch or the finalize path runs, then no 'Cache current' literal and no equivalent freshness claim is visible.

AC2: Given a stranded finalization with missing days, when the wave ends, then the visible end state is the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall ('{symbol} - backfill incomplete: {n} trading day(s) still missing ({preview}).{cause}') with unchanged wording.
AC3: Given a load with zero missing spans and no wave in flight, when the no-plans branch runs, then currency is still reported exactly as today ('{symbol} - {n} cached bars. Cache current.').

AC4: Given docs/requirements/requirements.md, when this batch lands, then the ### D41 through ### D52 sections (with reversals), the Existing Repository marker sentence, and the Current Tech Stack are intact, and no pre-D53 wording is touched.

tests.description: Offscreen in-flight wave and planner-missing-spans cases asserting the absence of the claim family (the 'Cache current' literal and equivalent freshness phrasings) at the no-plans branch and the finalize path while spans are missing or reqIds are in flight.
tests.expected_result: RED on the current tree (the no-plans branch claims without consulting the planner); GREEN after: no freshness claim visible in either case.

tests.description: Offscreen watchdog-stranded wave with missing days; assert the terminal status text equals the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall with the missing-days count, preview, and cause suffix.
tests.expected_result: Verbatim shortfall visible; no current-cache claim; wording byte-identical to the pre-change shortfall.

tests.description: Offscreen zero-missing no-wave load; assert the currency message reads exactly as today.
tests.expected_result: Currency still reported exactly as today; no regression on the covered path.

tests.description: File-content assertions over docs/requirements/requirements.md: the ### D41 through ### D52 headings exist, the Existing Repository marker sentence and Current Tech Stack block are present, and no pre-D53 section text changed (checked against the recorded pre-batch snapshot).
tests.expected_result: All history markers present; zero pre-D53 wording changes.
